name: ProsperoStore
description: Native app store for PS5 homebrew: browse this catalog, install apps and keep them up to date.
author: BlackBearReloaded
release_notes:
New ways to look around the catalog, and several fixes from your reports. Still an alpha version: please report problems.
- Developer pages. On an app's page, press R3 to see everything else its developer made, with a QR code for their page.
- What's new. Discover now has two shelves, New in the catalog and Recently updated, and Options has a News room with short messages from the catalog's maintainers.
- L1 and R1 go round. From the last section R1 goes to the first, and the same in the Options rooms. Requested by @Dark000Soldier.
- Hold Circle to close. On the home page, hold Circle until the bar fills and the store closes. A tap still does what it did.
- ProsperoEden game files survive an update. Older ProsperoEden versions kept games, keys and firmware inside the app's folder, and an update through the store made the library look empty. They are now moved to /data/prosperoeden during the update, including the ones an earlier update left in the store's previous folder. By @JMUtechnologies.
- No black screen when the store opens on consoles with VRR switched on.
- Slow networks. A download now waits twenty seconds for a slow server instead of five before giving up.
- Debug log. The switch stays on after the store is closed, also when the store couldn't get full access; switching it on records the console checks at once, so there is no need to reopen the store first. A failed download says where it stopped.
- Lapy helper updated to the version ProsperoEden uses, which is safe when the app closes while access is being granted.

Update from inside the store: it asks when it opens. To install by hand, unzip PPSA99000.zip and replace the PPSA99000 folder. If the console then says it can't start the app (CE-107750-0), see the note under Install in the README.

SHA256SUMS lists the ZIP's SHA-256. This release was built by GitHub Actions from the tag.
